answer: Treat every fresh key as an island: isolated, with no jury seat or vote until it links a verified external vault, collapsing many addresses into one entity. A sybil swarm then pays once per real identity, not once per address. Weight attestation by independent co-sitting history so a lone ember of honest work compounds over closes, while clusters that always co-agree get slashed against a random-sortition null. Reputation arrives like a slow comet, earned across many closes, never minted cheaply at the moment of join.
